title: kate-fileio: refuse a save onto a directory
summary: save returns a CreateTemp Io error when the target exists and is not a file. A missing path still creates the file. The test goes in the existing save tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: pub fn save(path: &Path, text: &Rope, opts: &EncodeOptions) -> Result<Saved, SaveError>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: save.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. At the start of save, before encode, write this exact check. Do not use the ? operator on metadata. A missing path is not an error. if let Ok(meta) = std::fs::metadata(path) { if !meta.is_file() { return Err(SaveError::Io { step: SaveStep::CreateTemp, source: std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, "not a regular file") }); } } Do not touch do_save, the encode call, the temp name, or the cleanup after do_save. The existing tests rename_over_existing_preserves_mode_bits and failed_write_leaves_target_untouched stay green. The test save_refuses_a_directory creates a directory named folder. save of the text x and a newline onto that directory returns SaveError::Io with step CreateTemp. The path is still a directory. A missing file note.txt in the same temp directory still saves. The bytes on disk are x and a newline. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: save::tests::save_refuses_a_directory
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. Saving onto a directory returns SaveStep::Rename. After the change the step is CreateTemp and the directory remains. A missing note.txt still saves the bytes x and a newline.
